name: nosignal-once
summary: v3: while "No signal" is already shown and its standby countdown runs, the input path's ~8 s detection rounds no longer re-enter it, so the countdown runs to standby; when a detection restart cleared the countdown, "No signal" is entered again and reloads it (v2 left it at 0: black screen, no standby)
status: v3 hardware-tested 2026-10-08 (automatic input, DP and laptop outputs disabled, deep standby, USB-C replugged: wake, "No signal", scan, "No signal" again, pre-standby; the stuck case of section 49 no longer occurs). v2 left the countdown at 0 after a restart during "No signal" (docs/firmware-map.md section 49)

sub_26A809 "No signal" store: movhi r12,0x45 -> j ns4
